header: Every entry runs under `--mode rust`. Tier `rust-only` runs through the rust-mode direct-host fixture and skips itself when Cargo or the fixture is unavailable; tier `pi-smoke` runs the Pi RPC process under Node and skips itself when Pi, node, or the built extension is unavailable, unless `EIDNARA_E2E_REQUIRE_PI=1` turns that skip into a failure. An entry whose every test is skipped carries `quarantined` with the reason; `validate-mode-manifest` refuses a fully skipped file without it and a marked file with live tests, and lists the quarantines it validated.

entries.rationale: replay-class prefix stability: pure-defer growth (A1), defer passes after an execute pass (A2), and aged eidnara_reduce survival (A3) through the incident-pool verifiers
defer-pass byte-stability of the system block and the retained message prefix

agent-loop cassette faithfulness: a recorded tool loop replays with the same tool-call sequence, arguments, request count, and outcome without entering the scripted block; a request past the recording is one typed miss that stops the run; a planted credential is refused before persistence
baseline-green incident variants executed in isolation through the incident-pool runner
the Pi RPC process loads the built extension, completes one mock turn with eidnara_search, eidnara_memory, and eidnara_note registered, and leaves no storage file in the isolated data directory
an agent eidnara_reduce drop enters the daemon queued-drop ledger and is consumed on the next producer-backed bust
entries.quarantined: the dropped tag survives the next bust under the lazy-drop policy; the scenario needs pressure for the drop to materialize

entries.rationale: served messages arrays keep tool_use ids unique when a queued drop is consumed
failure-mode drill 2: host crash mid-session keeps serving raw passes with a loud module failure and no placeholders
failure-mode drill 3: passes are served from the transform again after the host restarts, without restarting the session
entries.quarantined: six recovery prompts log seven pass lines after the restart (one reconnect retry), so the pass-count ceiling fails while the self-heal invariant holds; the ceiling must count prompts, not passes

entries.rationale: failure-mode drill 5: a paused host produces a transport timeout served raw, and passes recover after SIGCONT
content pressure past the execute threshold lands a fold whose m0 shrinks the provider wire
fixed-lead compaction timing arms reach fire, delayed publish, pending wait, Execute activation, emergency wait, and both revert cases, and emit per-run timing measurements
history_summarizer producer reaches the controlled backend and records a typed backend failure without killing a provider process
every pass sends the whole captured array, and a large provider-visible tail stays intact across multi-page sends
entries.quarantined: the large-tail invariant reads false against the paged module wire; the paging bound and tail preservation need re-derivation

entries.rationale: passes are served from transform again after a host restart or crash
passes are served from transform again after a mid-session message is reverted
entries.quarantined: OpenCode 1.18.22 session.revert leaves the reverted message rows in the session, so the harness never observes the removal it reacts to

entries.rationale: rust mode boots and transforms a real session through the host transport
retained wire messages are byte-identical across defer passes
passes are served from transform again after the newest user message is mutated in place
thinking-block wire safety: no nudge text in a signed assistant, dropped text shells, and image parts under whole-arc history
